facts.business: Sujala Trading & Holdings Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in investment in shares and securities, providing loans and credit facilities, and trading in stocks and shares.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is expecting a substantial higher demand in the domestic market during the next couple of years that will eventually pave the scope of business for the Company in the existing market and provide the opportunity in terms of an expanded and higher standard for the business operation of the Company in the near future.

auditor.name: G. C. Bafna & Co, Chartered Accountants
